answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13028 Country: India Title: While sitting in tashddud some scholers say we have to lift index finger continiously and some say's only when we reach ASHHADU LAILAHAILLALAH , what is correct and which is supporting hadit for these two views? Question: While sitting in tashddud some scholers say we have to lift index finger continiously and some say's only when we reach ASHHADU LAILAHAILLALAH , what is correct and which is supporting hadit for these two views? Answer ID: 13028 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 831/831=M/1430) The second way is preferable i.e. raise the fingers at la ilaha and put it down on illallah , it is supported by Hadith and traditions: وفي المحيط أنها سنة يرفعها عند النفي ويضعها عند الإثبات وهو قول أبي حنيفة ومحمد وكثرت به الآثار والأخبار فالعمل به أولى ا ه فهو صريح في أن المفتى به هو الإشارة بالمسبحة مع عقد الأصابع على الكيفية المذكورة لا مع بسطها (شامي 2:217) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
